title: Implement source/fact/answer graph and immutable versions
description: Implement DNF evidence support, typed semantic hashes, cycle rejection, topological ordering, reverse dirty closure and separate affected/recomputed/reused sets. A failed fetch makes freshness unknown. Do not equate content change with fact change. Baseline refreshes all answers from identical source observations. Implement baseline in the same endpoint via strategy=baseline with identical sources/model/limits. Both variants must work on unseen bounded inputs, not case IDs. PUBLIC BETA: Build the user-board constructor and refresh planner from real observations; do not match on sample IDs or strings. Track stable semantic IDs, explicit missing/deleted/conflicting/unknown states, reviewed vs model-proposed dependencies, content vs semantic versions and immutable revisions. Freshness is scoped to checked dependencies, never completeness of the web. Unknown dependency mapping conservatively marks answers for review. Requirement edits are labeled user changes, not web events. Use full signed server snapshot for prior observed history; reject tampered snapshots. Preserve custom question/title/source identity and output the BoardEnvelope update sets. Implement efficient no-change path, including source-check costs.

description: Copy agents/reference exactly into packages/ripple-mcp as the starting implementation, preserving its tests and license. Implement root test:mcp and package:integrations scripts; create the distributable kit using scripts/package-kit.py into public/downloads/ripple-agent-kit.zip plus SHA256, not a fictional npm package. The kit contains nine tools, two portable skills, Claude plugin manifest and a conflict-safe project-scope Claude/Codex configuration helper. Test import -> unverified -> rebuild, revision conflicts, persisted session, cancellation, two concurrent sessions and no secret output. No remote HTTP MCP, OAuth service, cloud board storage, auto-repo ingestion or global permission changes. See agents/BUILD-PLAN.md for exact paths and commands.
